content.title: Conservative Political Action Conference | Organization | C-SPAN.org
content.text: The Conservative Political Action Conference is an annual political conference attended by conservative activists and elected officials from across the United States. CPAC is hosted by the American Conservative Union . More than 100 other organizations contribute in various ways. Wikipedia* On the C-SPAN Networks: Conservative Political Action Conference has hosted 253 events in the C-SPAN Video Library; the first program was a 1986 Speech . The year with the most events was 2021 with eight events. The year with the highest average number of views per video was 2019 with an average of 61,005 views per video. Most appearances with Matt Schlapp ( 57 ), David A. Keene ( 42 ), Mercedes Schlapp ( 36 ). Most common tags: Conservatives , Republican Party , CPAC 2015 .
